verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe AI summaries generated as soon as an incident is declared, with stakeholder-tailored Audiences, plus a FireHydrant Scribe that joins incident bridges to capture discussions and decisions, and AI that captures Zoom chat insights. Together these cover live summarization and scribed call notes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of AI-drafted mid-incident stakeholder or status updates (Audiences summaries only imply this), detail on how summaries refresh as the incident evolves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
